function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-grounded investigation using only benchmark-tool results and return every relevant source with its exact source ID. Reconstruct how returned sources describe Conti as a ransomware-as-a-service operation; what publicly available Conti-related leaks (including chats, manuals, advertisements, victim-site material, or cryptocurrency/business records) reveal about its internal organization, hierarchy, roles, recruitment, affiliates, access brokers, negotiators, developers, administrators, operators, finances, operational procedures, relationships, and business model; and how law-enforcement records, indictments, sanctions, court filings, government advisories, incident reports, threat-intelligence reports, and other public attribution materials connect specific aliases, individuals, defendants, charges, proceedings, or assessments to Conti activity. Use only facts explicitly present in returned sources: do not infer identities, roles, relationships, chronology, or attribution. Distinguish established facts from allegations, reported claims, investigative or intelligence assessments, and unresolved uncertainty. Compare sources that agree or conflict. Treat jurisdiction, dates, languages, source types, and the meaning of Conti activity as open-ended. Produce detailed notes organized by source ID, quoting or closely paraphrasing the relevant evidence, and explicitly list unsupported or disputed links. Do not rely on outside knowledge or uncited claims."}
function.name: ConductResearch
